AI.tldr: 提出量子辅助潜空间代理模型，用PCA和卷积自编码器压缩高维物性场与响应场，再用参数化量子电路在潜空间建立映射并做随机变分推断，在1D/2D贝叶斯反演中于IonQ模拟器和Rigetti真机上验证，并加轻量去噪恢复精度。
AI.motivation: 贝叶斯反演常病态且计算昂贵（需大量高保真正演）；PQC混合量子-经典代理模型可利用NISQ硬件，但离散化后的参数场与响应场维度远高于近-term量子寄存器可嵌入规模，这是核心障碍。
AI.method: 利用电导率与势场的低内在维度：电导率用PCA降维、响应用卷积自编码器降维；训练PQC将潜电导率映射到潜响应；随机变分推断完全在潜空间进行。在1D和2D反问题上测试（信息性与非信息性先验），并在IonQ模拟器和Rigetti Cepheus-1-108Q上评估，引入轻量学习型去噪阶段。
AI.result: 1D和2D反问题在两类先验下均可完成反演；量子硬件评估中，轻量去噪阶段可将含噪结果的精度恢复至与无噪情形相差很小的残差水平。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间压缩是连接高维材料场与近-term小规模量子寄存器的可行桥梁，使PQC代理+潜空间变分推断在NISQ器件上具备实用性。

title: A deep energy method formulation for phase-field modelling of ductile fracture
summary: This work extends the Deep Energy Method to phase-field modelling of ductile fracture in elasto-plastic solids. Its key contribution is an incremental DEM-based formulation that couples history-dependent J2 plasticity and plasticity-dependent fracture toughness with separate energy-optimised displacement and phase-field representations. The formulation combines the second-order Ambrosio-Tortorelli phase-field fracture model with small-strain J2 plasticity and linear isotropic hardening. A volumetric-deviatoric split defines the elastic crack-driving energy, while accumulated equivalent plastic strain governs the degradation of local fracture toughness. Plastic internal variables are updated locally through radial return. The reduced energy is minimised alternately with respect to the displacement and phase fields, represented by a ReZero residual neural network and spatially localised Gaussian radial basis functions with trainable centres, respectively. This split addresses the diffuse phase-field profiles observed in preliminary calculations with a shared global network. Alternating optimisation is combined with transfer learning to reuse trainable parameters and optimiser states across loading increments, while the converged constitutive history is carried forward separately at quadrature points. The numerical results demonstrate close agreement with finite-element reference solutions in predicting force-displacement responses, energy evolution, plastic deformation and crack propagation. The framework captures the main features of ductile fracture, although accuracy becomes more sensitive to loading increments near abrupt fracture events.

AI.tldr: 将深度能量法(DEM)扩展至弹塑性固体延性断裂的相场建模，提出增量式表述，耦合J2塑性、塑性相关断裂韧性与分离的位移/相场表示，结果与有限元参考解吻合。
AI.motivation: 相场断裂在弹塑性延性断裂中的建模具有历史依赖性，传统DEM难以处理；同时初步计算中共享全局网络导致相场剖面过于弥散，需要新的表示策略。
AI.method: 耦合二阶Ambrosio-Tortorelli相场模型与小应变J2塑性及线性各向同性硬化；采用体积-偏量分解定义弹性裂纹驱动力，累积等效塑性应变控制局部断裂韧性退化，塑性内变量通过径向回映局部更新。能量最小化对位移场（ReZero残差网络）与相场（带可训练中心的空间局部高斯径向基函数）交替进行；结合迁移学习跨加载增量复用参数与优化器状态，本构历史在积分点单独传递。
AI.result: 在力-位移响应、能量演化、塑性变形与裂纹扩展预测上与有限元参考解高度吻合；框架能捕捉延性断裂主要特征，但在突发断裂事件附近精度对加载增量更敏感。
AI.conclusion: 该增量DEM框架可有效实现延性断裂相场模拟，分离表示解决了相场弥散问题，迁移学习提升效率；后续可改进突发断裂处对增量的稳健性。

title: Standardized Planck-Mean Absorption Coefficients for High-Temperature Gases
summary: Planck-mean absorption coefficients of pure gases are calculated from line-by-line integrations of HITEMP and ExoMol spectra up to 5000 K for use in high-enthalpy radiative heat transfer simulations. The dataset extends beyond conventional combustion products, including high-temperature radicals, nitrogen-bearing species, soot precursors, metal oxides, metal hydrides, and halides: AlF, AlH, AlO, BH, C2, C2H2, CH, CH4, CN, CO, CO2, H2O, HBO, HCN, HF, MgH, MgO, N2O, NO, NO2, OH, SiO, TiH, TiO. New calculations are validated against historical correlations for overlapping species, demonstrating good agreement over their applicable temperature ranges. Strong visible opacities result in large Planck-mean absorption coefficients for many of the considered species, highlighting the need to account for their radiative contribution in extreme environments. A brute-force search over several candidate functional forms is performed to provide a common set of coefficients, establishing a standardized framework that can be easily integrated into production solvers and extended as additional high-temperature line lists become available.

AI.tldr: 本文基于HITEMP与ExoMol谱线逐线积分，计算了25种纯气体在最高5000 K下的Planck平均吸收系数，并给出统一拟合公式，供高焓辐射传热仿真使用。
AI.motivation: 高焓辐射传热仿真需要超出常规燃烧产物范围的高温气体吸收系数，而现有数据多局限于燃烧组分与较低温度。
AI.method: 利用HITEMP和ExoMol谱线表进行逐线积分，计算AlF、AlO、C2、CN、CO、CO2、H2O、HCN、NO、OH、SiO、TiO等25种物种的Planck平均吸收系数（至5000 K）；与历史关联式交叉验证；并对多种候选函数形式进行暴力搜索以选出统一系数集。
AI.result: 新计算在重叠物种上与历史关联式在其适用温度范围内吻合良好；许多物种因可见光区强不透明度而具有较大的Planck平均吸收系数。
AI.conclusion: 极端环境下必须考虑这些物种的辐射贡献；所提供的标准化系数框架可方便嵌入生产求解器，并随新谱线表的发布而扩展。

title: A nonequilibrium-capturing unified gas-kinetic scheme I: discrete orthogonal basis construction and expansion on velocity space
summary: Velocity space discretization is a primary source of computational cost in deterministic methods for multiscale gas flows. A fixed velocity grid often retains redundant kinetic degrees of freedom (DOFs), particularly under near equilibrium conditions. To address this issue, this work develops a nonequilibrium-capturing formulation based on the unified gas kinetic scheme (UGKS), in which the number of kinetic DOFs adapts locally to the degree of nonequilibrium. A discrete orthogonal basis is constructed for numerical implementation, and the velocity distribution function is decomposed into an analytical local equilibrium and a basis expanded nonequilibrium component. The retained, locally adapted DOFs are evolved directly, substantially lowering computational overhead while preserving the discrete conservation of mass, momentum, and energy, as well as accurately capturing nonequilibrium states. The formulation retains the core multiscale coupling of molecular transport and collision inherent to UGKS, providing explicit and implicit schemes for unsteady and steady flows, respectively. Numerical tests across a wide range of flow speeds and rarefaction regimes (from continuum to highly rarefied) demonstrate close agreement with benchmark solutions. For unsteady flows, the explicit scheme achieves speedups of 12.64 to 58.50 over the standard UGKS. In steady state tests, only about $2\%$ of the original kinetic DOFs are required in continuum regions, accelerating each implicit iteration by a factor of 33.87. Even in the most rarefied cases, the scheme captures nonequilibrium behavior using only about $27\%$ of the original DOFs.

AI.tldr: 提出基于UGKS的非平衡自适应速度空间离散格式，用局部自适应动能自由度配合离散正交基展开，在保持守恒性与多尺度耦合的同时大幅降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 多尺度气体流动的确定性方法中，速度空间离散是主要计算开销来源；固定速度网格在近平衡区保留大量冗余动能自由度，造成浪费。
AI.method: 在统一气体动理学格式(UGKS)框架下构建非平衡捕捉型公式：构造离散正交基，将速度分布函数分解为解析局部平衡部分与基展开的非平衡部分，直接演化局部自适应的保留自由度；保留UGKS的分子输运与碰撞多尺度耦合，并分别给出非定常(显式)与定常(隐式)格式。
AI.result: 在从连续到高度稀薄的宽流速与稀薄度范围内与基准解吻合良好；非定常显式格式相对标准UGKS加速12.64–58.50倍；定常测试连续区仅需约2%原始动能自由度，单次隐式迭代加速33.87倍；最稀薄工况也仅用约27%自由度即可捕捉非平衡行为。
AI.conclusion: 自适应动能自由度方法在保持离散质量、动量、能量守恒与稀薄非平衡捕捉能力的前提下显著降低计算开销，为多尺度气体流动的高效确定性模拟提供了可行方案。

title: GeONet: Geometry-Encoded Operator Network for Predicting Flow in Heterogeneous Porous Media
summary: Rapid prediction of pressure-driven flow in microfluidic porous media is important for experimental design, tracer-test interpretation, and digital-twin development for subsurface energy and critical mineral applications. High-fidelity simulations resolve geometry-controlled flow but are computationally expensive across large geometry ensembles. Here, we introduce GeONet, a Geometry-Encoded Operator Network that predicts steady-state pressure fields by jointly representing material properties, spatial coordinates, and solid--void geometry. GeONet extends the Branch--Trunk architecture with a dedicated Leaf Network encoding the binary domain mask through multiscale features. The Branch Network represents porosity and permeability, the Trunk Network combines coordinates with local geometric descriptors and random Fourier features, and a gated DeepMixer integrates these representations to predict pressure. GeONet was trained and evaluated using 5,000 PFLOTRAN simulations of heterogeneous Reduced Complexity Platform domains, comprising nearly 30 TB of data. Comparisons with pore-scale Stokes solutions across three geometries yielded Pearson correlations of 0.987--0.991 and $R^2$ values of 0.974--0.982, supporting PFLOTRAN as reference data. Under matched partitions and two-stage hyperparameter optimization, GeONet substantially outperformed a boundary-condition-aware DeepONet baseline. Across three held-out domains, GeONet achieved NRMSE of 0.0381--0.0500, MAPE of 1.76--2.59%, and $R^2$ of 0.9673--0.9822, versus 0.1483--0.2040, 7.81--10.45%, and 0.5658--0.7126 for DeepONet, respectively. On three additional unseen geometries, GeONet achieved NRMSE of 0.0448--0.0676 and $R^2$ of 0.9511--0.9770. These results demonstrate improved accuracy, pressure-range preservation, and cross-geometry generalization through explicit geometry encoding.

AI.tldr: GeONet：一种几何编码算子网络，通过Leaf网络显式编码多孔介质几何，联合学习材料属性、坐标与固-空几何，实现微流控多孔介质压力场快速高精度预测。
AI.motivation: 微流控多孔介质的压力驱动流快速预测对实验设计、示踪测试解释及地下能源/关键矿物数字孪生很重要，但高保真数值模拟在大规模几何集合上计算昂贵，需要兼顾精度与效率的代理模型。
AI.method: 提出GeONet，扩展Branch–Trunk架构：Branch网络编码孔隙度与渗透率，Trunk网络结合坐标、局部几何描述符与随机傅里叶特征，并新增Leaf网络通过多尺度特征编码二值域掩膜，最后由门控DeepMixer融合预测压力。训练与评估基于5000个PFLOTRAN模拟、近30TB的异质RCP域数据，并与物理感知DeepONet基线在两阶段超参优化下对比。
AI.result: 与三个几何的孔隙尺度Stokes解对比，Pearson相关0.987–0.991、R² 0.974–0.982，支持PFLOTRAN作为参考。三个留出域上GeONet NRMSE 0.0381–0.0500、MAPE 1.76–2.59%、R² 0.9673–0.9822，显著优于DeepONet（0.1483–0.2040、7.81–10.45%、0.5658–0.7126）。三个未见几何上NRMSE 0.0448–0.0676、R² 0.9511–0.9770。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何编码使GeONet在精度、压力范围保持与跨几何泛化上均优于基线，可作为多孔介质压力场快速预测的高效代理模型。

title: Online reduced-order modeling from primal solver trajectories for PDE-constrained optimization
summary: Repeated high-fidelity state and gradient evaluations make large-scale PDE-constrained optimization computationally expensive. Reduced-order modeling provides a natural way to reduce the cost of these repeated high-dimensional computations. However, existing reduced-order modeling approaches often rely on converged high-fidelity states for model construction or updating, while their reduced spaces may lose accuracy as the design moves beyond the region represented by the available data. To address these limitations, we present Reduced-order Trajectory-based Optimization (RETO), an online framework that constructs local reduced-order models (ROMs) directly from unconverged primal solver trajectories. Each local ROM is built from snapshots collected during a finite number of high-fidelity primal iterations, without requiring full-order convergence, and supports multiple low-cost state evaluations, adjoint-based gradient evaluations, and design updates. New solver trajectories are generated at updated design points to reconstruct the local ROM and continue the optimization. Across three distinct PDE-constrained optimization problems, RETO achieves solution quality comparable to that of full-order optimization, with speedups of approximately 8 to 22 times in cases without discontinuities in the state fields. Even in the transonic inverse-design case involving moving shocks, RETO retains an approximately threefold speedup. The transonic results further show that the online local ROM progressively captures evolving shock-related flow features as new primal solver trajectories are incorporated. These results demonstrate the value of unconverged primal solver trajectories as an online information source for reduced-order optimization, allowing the reduced basis to evolve with the design rather than requiring a basis that covers the entire design space in advance.

AI.tldr: 提出在线降阶优化框架RETO，利用未收敛原始求解器轨迹构建局部降阶模型，实现8–22倍加速（含激波情形约3倍）。
AI.motivation: 大规模PDE约束优化中反复高保真状态与梯度评估计算昂贵；现有降阶模型依赖已收敛的高保真状态构建/更新，且降阶空间在设计远离已有数据区域时会失效。
AI.method: RETO在线框架：从有限步高保真原始迭代（无需收敛）中收集快照，构建局部ROM；每个局部ROM支持多次低成本状态评估、伴随梯度评估与设计更新；在设计点更新后重新生成求解器轨迹以重建局部ROM并继续优化，使降阶基随设计演化。
AI.result: 在三个不同PDE约束优化问题上，解质量与全阶优化相当；状态场无间断时加速约8–22倍；含移动激波的跨声速反问题仍有约3倍加速，并显示局部ROM随轨迹累积逐步捕捉激波相关流动特征。
AI.conclusion: 未收敛原始求解器轨迹可作为降阶优化的在线信息源，使降阶基随设计演化，而无需预先覆盖整个设计空间。

title: Learning to reconstruct Germano Differential Filtered Fields with Convolutional Neural Networks for Large Eddy Simulation of Plasma Turbulence
summary:
We present a novel method which combines the invertibility of the differential filter of Germano, with convolutional networks to accelerate plasma turbulence simulations. Rather than learning the mapping from coarse-grid LES fields to fine-grid DNS, the proposed method learns the mapping from coarse LES fields to the differential-filtered DNS fields. We then use the inverse of Germano's filter to reconstruct the fine-scale details and hence calculate exactly the nonlinear terms in the governing equations and subgrid-scale terms in the LES equations.
  The method is tested on the 2D Hasegawa-Wakatani (HW) and modified Hasegawa-Wakatani (mHW) plasma turbulence models at $256^2$ and $512^2$ DNS resolutions using 2, 4 and 8 times smaller LES grids in each direction. We compare the model with DNS results on energy, enstrophy, spectra, probability distributions, poloidal and radial fluxes and computational cost. Validation extends to 1000 simulation time units for HW and 100 for mHW, whose faster dynamics lead toward laminarization.
  For the $256^2$ cases, the finer LES meshes preserve several integral and spectral features, whereas the coarsest mesh yields unphysical behavior. In contrast, for the $512^2$ cases, even the coarsest LES mesh preserves the turbulent character of the flow and maintains acceptable statistics for both the HW and mHW models. Moreover, we show how our methodology is superior to traditional algebraic numerical LES models, which traditionally fail to capture important design features. Finally, benchmarks show an MPI task-time reductions of 4.82--49.45, with a maximum wall-clock speedup of $1.55\times$ when compared to full CPU socket.

AI.tldr: 结合Germano微分滤波器可逆性与卷积网络加速等离子体湍流模拟，通过学习LES场到滤波DNS场的映射再逆滤波重建细节，在HW/mHW模型上验证并优于传统LES模型，取得最高1.55倍墙钟加速。
AI.motivation: 等离子体湍流DNS计算代价高昂，传统代数LES模型难以捕捉重要设计特征，需要一种更准确且高效的加速方法。
AI.method: 不直接学习粗网格LES到细网格DNS的映射，而是学习粗网格LES场到微分滤波DNS场的映射，再利用Germano滤波的逆重建细尺度细节，从而精确计算非线性项与亚格子项；在2D Hasegawa-Wakatani及修正模型上以256²/512² DNS、2/4/8倍粗化LES网格测试。
AI.result: 256²情形下较细LES网格保留积分与谱特征，最粗网格出现非物理行为；512²情形下即使最粗网格也保持湍流特性与可接受统计量；方法优于传统代数LES模型；MPI任务时间降低4.82–49.45倍，最大墙钟加速1.55倍。
AI.conclusion: 可逆微分滤波与卷积网络结合是加速等离子体湍流模拟的有效途径，在高分辨率下粗网格仍能保持统计精度，并带来显著计算收益。

title: LAO+: Focused, Multi-Replica Accelerated Orthogonal Sampling for Robust Binding Free Energy Predictions
summary: We introduce Lambda-ABF-OPES+ ($\text{LAO+}$), a multi-replica framework for absolute binding free energy (ABFE) calculations that accelerates both the alchemical transformation and the slow ``orthogonal'' motions coupled to it. At the core of $\text{LAO+}$ is a partitioned $λ$-dynamics scheme that concentrates sampling on the abrupt rehydration of the binding pocket, the main bottleneck of ligand decoupling, while Hamiltonian replica exchange relays configurations along the entire alchemical path. This drives a fourfold gain in convergence speed for the rate-limiting leg over our previous $\text{LAO}$ method, which was itself up to ninefold faster than Lambda-ABF, an overall gain of up to $\sim$36-fold. Applied to 28 protein--ligand complexes across five targets, $\text{LAO+}$ achieves a root-mean-square error of 0.83~kcal~mol$^{-1}$ and a correlation of 0.87 with experiment from only 63~ns of sampling per ligand. Moreover, dedicated reservoir replicas accelerate any slow degree of freedom that can be described by a collective variable. We demonstrate this by recovering hidden protein and ligand conformational states, for example in T4 lysozyme, BRD4 and JNK1. Together, these advances make accurate ABFE calculations practical for drug discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出LAO+多副本框架，加速炼金变换及耦合的正交慢运动，实现比Lambda-ABF最多约36倍加速，28个蛋白-配体复合物RMSE 0.83 kcal/mol，相关0.87，仅需63 ns采样/配体。
AI.motivation: 绝对结合自由能（ABFE）计算中，配体解耦过程受结合口袋突然再水化的瓶颈限制，且存在与炼金变换耦合的"正交"慢运动；现有方法收敛慢，难以用于实际药物发现。
AI.method: 多副本框架LAO+：核心为分区λ动力学方案，将采样集中于结合口袋再水化的突变段；采用Hamiltonian副本交换沿整个炼金路径传递构型；并加入专用"储库"副本（reservoir replicas），可加速任何由集体变量描述的慢自由度。
AI.result: 在限速段上比此前LAO快4倍，比Lambda-ABF最多快约36倍。在5个靶点28个蛋白-配体复合物上，每配体仅63 ns采样即达RMSE 0.83 kcal/mol、与实验相关0.87。成功恢复隐藏构象态（如T4溶菌酶、BRD4、JNK1）。
AI.conclusion: LAO+显著提升ABFE收敛效率与精度，并兼具探测慢构象自由度的通用能力，使精确ABFE计算在药物发现中变得实用。
